title: Antam Posts 240% Net Profit Surge in 1H25, Fueled by Nickel and Gold, While Advancing ESG and Smelter Projects
body: PT Antam’s first‑half 2025 net profit jumped 240% to Rp5.14 trillion, driven by nickel sales that rose 125% to Rp7.87 trillion and production of 9.10 Mt of ore, while gold sales climbed 163% to Rp49.54 trillion. The company also advanced its ESG roadmap—cutting scope 1/2 emissions by 15.8%, boosting renewable energy by 10%, and rehabilitating 75% of impacted land—alongside commissioning its SGAR alumina smelter and expanding battery‑EV supply chain facilities.

title: PT Timah Tbk Reports 32% Drop in Tin Production, Seeks Regulatory Support in RDP with DPR VI
body: During a Rapat Dengar Pendapat on 22 September 2025, PT Timah Tbk disclosed a 32% YoY decline in tin ore production to 6,997 t Sn and a 29% drop in tin metal output to 6,870 t, alongside a 19% revenue fall to Rp4.22 trillion, yet maintained an average selling price of USD 32,816 (up 8%). The company outlined plans to open new mines, deploy 60 production suction vessels, expand CSR and cooperative mining, and requested DPR VI’s support to streamline regulations on illegal mining, hilirisasi, and coastal zoning to revive output and boost national revenue.
